chart.name: Total network I/O

publishLabelOptions.displayName: Indicator for nil Windows interface transmissions
publishLabelOptions.label: C

chart.programText:
A = data('if_octets.tx', filter=(not filter('agent', '*')),rollup='rate').sum().scale(8).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('if_octets.tx', filter=filter('host_kernel_name', 'windows'),rollup='rate').scale(8).sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A).count().below(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (B*(C+1)).publish(label='D')
E = (B).count().below(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (A*(E+1)).publish(label='F')
G = (A+B).sum().publish(label='G')
H = data('if_octets.rx', filter=(not filter('agent', '*')),rollup='rate').sum().scale(8).publish(label='H', enable=False)
I = data('if_octets.rx', filter=filter('host_kernel_name', 'windows'),rollup='rate').scale(8).sum().publish(label='I', enable=False)
J = (H).count().below(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='J', enable=False)
K = (H*(L+1)).publish(label='K')
L = (I).count().below(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='L', enable=False)
M = (I*(J+1)).publish(label='M')
N = (H+I).sum().publish(label='N')

chart.name: Total network errors
chart.programText:
A = data('if_errors.rx',rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('if_errors.tx',rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (C).count().below(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='D', enable=False)
H = data('if_errors.rx', filter=filter('host_kernel_name', 'windows'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='H', enable=False)
I = data('if_errors.tx', filter=filter('host_kernel_name', 'windows'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='I', enable=False)
J = (H+I).publish(label='J', enable=False)
K = (J).count().below(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='K', enable=False)
L = (J*(D+1)).sum().publish(label='L')
M = (C*(K+1)).sum().publish(label='M')
N = (C+J).sum().publish(label='N')

chart.name: Top mem page swaps/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('vmpage_io.swap.in', filter=(not filter('agent', '*')),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('vmpage_io.swap.out', filter=(not filter('agent', '*')),rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).mean(by=['host']).top(count=10).publish(label='C')
D = data('vmpage.swap.total_per_second').mean(by=['host']).top(count=10).publish(label='D')

chart.name: CPU %
chart.programText:
A = data('cpu.utilization', filter=(not filter('agent', '*'))).mean(by=['host']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).max().publish(label='B')
C = (A).min().publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='E')
F = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='F')
